title: Dhamaal 4 Just Crossed ₹65 Crore in Three Days. The Franchise Has Never Done This.
excerpt: A ₹14 crore Friday, a ₹22 crore Saturday, and a ₹28 crore Sunday later, the fourth instalment of Bollywood's most chaotic franchise has smashed every record the series ever set — and it's about to hit ₹100 crore worldwide.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Dhamaal 4 earned ₹65 crore in its opening weekend, setting a franchise record.
  • Sunday alone brought in ₹28.50 crore, the highest single day in franchise history.
  • The film's worldwide gross reached ₹92 crore in just three days.
  • Mumbai led with 55.5% occupancy, indicating strong audience interest.
  • Over 12.53 lakh tickets were sold, mostly through walk-ins, not pre-sales.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=IG-eByZdz6Y There is something deeply satisfying about watching a franchise that everyone had written off prove the entire industry wrong. **Dhamaal 4** opened on Friday to a respectable ₹14 crore. By Saturday it had doubled. And by Sunday evening, it was clear that something unusual was happening in theatres across the country. The numbers are staggering. **₹28.50 crore on Sunday alone** — the single biggest day in the franchise's nineteen-year history. Combined with Saturday's ₹22.50 crore and Friday's ₹14 crore, the opening weekend stands at **₹65 crore net**, officially dethroning **Total Dhamaal's** ₹62.40 crore weekend from 2019 as the franchise's all-time best. But here's the number that really matters: the worldwide gross has hit **₹92 crore** in just three days. That ₹100 crore milestone? It's practically tomorrow. ## The Sunday Surge Was Something Else Sunday's occupancy figures tell a story of a film that caught fire through word of mouth. Mumbai led the charge at **55.5% overall occupancy**, with evening shows hitting an extraordinary **80%**. That's not a comedy entertainer number — that's a blockbuster number. Ahmedabad wasn't far behind at 55%, with NCR at 45% and Pune and Bengaluru both crossing the high 40s. > **"Mumbai led the charge at **55.5% overall occupancy**, with evening shows hitting an extraordinary **80%**."** The Hindi 2D version started its Sunday at 22% occupancy in the morning. By afternoon it was 56%. By evening it had climbed to **71.62%**. That kind of crescendo doesn't happen without audience excitement building through the day — parents texting friends, WhatsApp groups lighting up, families deciding to catch the last show. On **BookMyShow**, the film crossed **12.53 lakh tickets** sold over the weekend. Pre-sales accounted for just 92,000 of those — meaning the overwhelming majority of the audience showed up organically. Walk-ins outpaced app bookings on Sunday, which is the clearest possible signal that Dhamaal 4 has become an event. ## The Franchise Has Earned This ![Mumbai — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/2b/Mumbai_Bandra-Worli_Sea_Link.jpg) Look at the trajectory: > **Dhamaal** (2007): ₹7.08 crore weekend > **Double Dhamaal** (2011): ₹21.75 crore weekend > **Total Dhamaal** (2019): ₹62.40 crore weekend > **Dhamaal 4** (2026): ₹65.00 crore weekend Each instalment has roughly tripled the last. Director **Indra Kumar** has turned what began as a slapstick experiment into one of Bollywood's most reliable commercial properties. And the ensemble — **Ajay Devgn**, **Riteish Deshmukh**, **Arshad Warsi**, and **Javed Jaffrey** — haven't just shown up. They've shown up at peak energy.

The film carries a poignant undercurrent too. It serves as an emotional tribute to the late **Satish Kaushik**, whose presence in the franchise is deeply felt even in his absence. The audience response suggests they came for the laughs and stayed for the love. ## What's Next With the weekday drop already visible — Monday's early estimate is around ₹5-6 crore, a standard post-weekend correction for a mass entertainer — the real question is whether Dhamaal 4 can sustain momentum through the week. If it holds ₹3-4 crore daily through Thursday, a ₹85 crore first week is well within reach. The overseas market has contributed ₹14 crore gross, with North America alone at $322,000 through Saturday. For a franchise that was never considered a global brand, that's a quiet milestone. ## The Diaspora Angle

For viewers in the US, UK, and Canada, Dhamaal 4 is playing across major chains. The North American numbers suggest strong interest among the Indian diaspora, particularly in cities with large Gujarati and Maharashtrian communities where the franchise has always had its deepest roots. If you haven't caught it yet, the weekend rush might be gone — but the film clearly has the kind of legs that keep screens allocated well into week two. Bollywood comedies rarely get this kind of theatrical run anymore. Dhamaal 4 just reminded everyone why they should.
